messages:
ana: FYI -- hit a provisioning stall in eu-central today. Multiple GPU attaches stuck; provisioner shows PROVISIONING_HOLD. I traced to a cohort of hosts with nvme write latency spikes.
mike: any SMART data or kernel oops?
sre-bot: [ALERT] eu-central-cohort-9: nvme_write_99th=1.9s -> 6.4s; correctable_errors +9 over 25m.
ana: (typo) ana: d'oh. dmesg excerpt from host ec-9-12: 
```
[1761234520.012] nvme0: timeout cmd 0x1b
[1761234521.100] blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 98304
```
mike: looks like scrub/reclaimer churn overlapped with a big onboarding wave. Janitor was ramped up for a scale test.
carla: mitigation: reduce janitor concurrency for that cohort to 2, label nodes to block new onboards, and shift urgent queues to fallback region for 30m.
ana: patching now: 
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap janitor-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"max_workers":"2","cohort_overrides":"eu-central-cohort-9:2"}}'
kubectl label nodes -l cohort=eu-central-cohort-9 no-new-onboard=true
```
sre-bot: [INFO] patch applied by ana at 1761234535. janitor max_workers=2 for eu-central-cohort-9.
mike: quick iostat 60s after patch: 
```
Device      r/s    w/s   await
nvme0n1     0.08  110.00  6.1
nvme1n1     0.03   25.00  0.9
```
carla: attach success rate moved from ~88% -> 97% after the throttle. Queue drained. Scheduling SMART long test on 2 suspect hosts overnight.
cost-team: note: cross-region fallback for critical lanes will add ~€350 for the window. Approve?
ana: approved for critical lanes only. Opened ticket INFRA-4812 to track replacements, SMART ingestion, and schedule janitor blackout windows during peak onboarding.
mike: long term asks in the ticket: 1) cap default janitor concurrency at 4, 2) add scrub scheduler blackout configurable per cohort, 3) auto-node-labeling when nvme error rate > threshold.
carla: also adding a temporary k8s cron to label nodes if nvme media_errors > 3 in 20m. Will roll back after remediation.
ana: thanks team. I'll keep the dashboard pinned and post a follow-up after the SMART runs. :thumbsup:
